questions_answered.q01_task_selector: Top-bar global TaskSelector (web/src/components/common/TaskSelector.jsx) synchronizing URL query param task_id/taskId and Redux state.tasks.currentTask.
questions_answered.q02_investigation_id_source: Automatically resolved by backend if omitted; projected in candidate records as c.investigation_id.
questions_answered.q03_analysis_workspace_panels: EvidenceAnalysisPanel (file context or evidence key) and EventAnalysisPanel (event narrative and corroborating evidence).
questions_answered.q04_reusable_finding_review_ui: ClaimList.jsx (web/src/pages/Investigation/components/ClaimList.jsx) providing badge variants for assertion class, review status, grounding, and accept/reject actions.
questions_answered.q05_evidence_citation_viewer: Investigation.jsx onTraceEvidence(evidenceKey) sets selectedEvidenceKey, routing AnalysisWorkspace to EvidenceAnalysisPanel.
questions_answered.q06_review_candidate_json_schema: ReviewCandidateProjection: candidate_id, target_type, target_id, claim_type, content, evidence_refs, source_revision, source_integration_id, grounding_status, review_status, candidate_hash, created_at, reviewed_at, reviewer, review_note.
questions_answered.q07_candidate_id_special_characters: Yes, finding candidate IDs include colons (e.g. finding:disp_f_01); client encodes via encodeURIComponent(candidateId).
questions_answered.q08_task_scope_verification: Backend validates task_id via cpp_backend.get_task(task_id) and scopes SQLite queries by WHERE task_id = ? AND investigation_id = ?.
questions_answered.q09_post_review_mutation_fields: task_id, investigation_id, review_target_id, expected_source_revision, expected_candidate_hash, decision, reviewer, request_id, note, requested_assertion_class.
questions_answered.q11_http_layer_auth: Desktop/single-user development mode; no cryptographic session tokens; acknowledged as REVIEWER_AUTHENTICATION_LIMITATION.
questions_answered.q12_toast_error_polling_mechanism: useToast (ToastContext.jsx) providing toast.success/error/warning/info; pythonApi error payload provides status, message, data.detail.
